judgements.name: how fast the order book converts
judgements.why: the company does not disclose a delivery schedule, so neither reading can be settled from what it publishes; both are published and the study takes no side

judgements.name: minority interests
judgements.adopted: their share of value, proxied by the filed profit share
judgements.why: the model capitalises all of the subsidiaries' cash flow, so the minority's claim is worth its share of that value and not what it historically cost

judgements.name: equity risk premium basis
judgements.why: the market's own live pricing of the sovereign's credit, against an agency judgement updated in steps; both are published

judgements.name: terminal growth
judgements.adopted: inflation only, zero real, on the house macro path
judgements.why: 15% nominal growth in perpetuity against a terminal rate embedding 7% inflation is eight points of real growth a year for ever, which nothing disclosed supports
